title: Stalks commute with direct sums of sheaf modules
statement: Let $(X,\mathcal O_X)$ be a ringed space [def-weil-locally-ringed-space-morphism], let $I$ be a set, and let $(\mathcal F_i)_{i\in I}$ be sheaves of $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. For every $x\in X$, the canonical $\mathcal O_{X,x}$-linear map from the stalk of the coproduct to the coproduct of the stalks is an isomorphism $$(\bigoplus_{i\in I}\mathcal F_i)_x\;\xrightarrow{\sim}\;\bigoplus_{i\in I}(\mathcal F_i)_x,$$ where the coproducts are taken in the category of sheaves of $\mathcal O_X$-modules and of $\mathcal O_{X,x}$-modules, respectively.

source.place: Section 009E (section-limits-sheaves), item (5), stalks commute with colimits; applied to the coproduct diagram

proof.text: Let T = SheafOfModules.forget R followed by PresheafOfModules.moduleStalkFunctor R.obj x. Its underlying abelian-group functor is definitionally SheafOfModules.toSheaf R followed by the abelian sheaf stalk functor. The former preserves coproducts by moduleSheaves_colimits_forgetful, applied to Discrete I. The latter is a left adjoint by Mathlib TopCat.stalkSkyscraperSheafAdjunction, so preserves colimits. Therefore T followed by the module-to-abelian-group forgetful functor preserves coproducts. That forgetful functor reflects colimits (Mathlib ModuleCat.Colimits), so T preserves coproducts by preservesColimitsOfShape_of_reflects_of_preserves.

Compose PreservesCoproduct.iso T F with ModuleCat.coprodIsoDirectSum (fun i => T.obj (F i)). The resulting categorical isomorphism has exactly the requested source and target module carriers. Its toLinearEquiv gives the required linear equivalence. This uses only the universal property of a coproduct, and works also for an empty index set.

By PreservesCoproduct.inv_hom, the forward comparison is the inverse of sigmaComparison. Apply map_ι_comp_inv_sigmaComparison and ModuleCat.ι_coprodIsoDirectSum_hom to obtain T.map (Sigma.ι F i) followed by the composite isomorphism equals ModuleCat.ofHom (DirectSum.lof _ I _ i). Apply this morphism equality to germ s. By the definition of the module stalk map and Mathlib TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor_map_germ_apply, T.map (Sigma.ι F i) sends germ s to the germ of the sheaf coproduct injection applied to s. This proves precisely the displayed compatibility with germs.
